evals.name: adam-algorithm-and-convergence
evals.prompt: 请精读 arXiv:1412.6980（Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization）的最新版本，用中文为没有优化算法背景的读者制作完整学习笔记。按论文顶层章节拆分 Markdown 文件，既要讲清直觉，也要保留关键公式、算法、假设、实验结果和局限。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese close reading under notes/, a root-level unfilled SUMMARY.CARD.md, and a root-level REPRODUCT.md whose atomic TODOs reproduce Adam's central algorithmic and empirical claims through a pinned official path when available and an independent mechanism check.
expectations: The output root contains REPRODUCT.md, SUMMARY.CARD.md, and notes/00.abstract.md, with one ordered note file for every substantive top-level paper section and substantive appendix; the bundled validator accepts the output.
SUMMARY.CARD.md contains 8-12 numbered Adam-specific questions, blank response and confidence fields, a post-check error-repair section, and no answers, hints, expected keywords, or answer key.

The card tests Adam's moment estimates, bias correction, update behavior, empirical evidence, convergence assumptions or failure conditions, a counterfactual, and transfer to a new optimization setting without embedding the answers in its questions.
The notes accurately explain the Adam update equations, define every central symbol, and use a worked or conceptual example to explain why the first- and second-moment estimates are bias-corrected.
The notes report important default hyperparameters and headline empirical comparisons with source locators, while distinguishing reported evidence from broader interpretation.
The convergence discussion identifies the paper version's actual assumptions and scope rather than presenting Adam as universally convergent.

notes/00.abstract.md contains a claim-evidence table, limitations, a prerequisite glossary for entering the section notes, a complete linked reading map, and valid relative links to ../SUMMARY.CARD.md and ../REPRODUCT.md.
Each substantive section ends with at least two active-recall questions whose answers are hidden in collapsed details blocks.

Central formulas, exact values, comparisons, and limitations are reverse-traceable to source locators; notation remains consistent across files, and every invented example is visibly labeled as teaching material and sanity-checked.

REPRODUCT.md maps Adam's update mechanism, bias correction or convergence scope, and central empirical comparisons to consecutive target IDs with paper locators, predefined acceptance rules, and named evidence artifacts.

REPRODUCT.md uses consecutive unchecked atomic task IDs; each task has Action, Run class, Inputs, Produces, Done when, Source, Depends on, and Targets fields, and gives every configuration-seed pair its own task rather than one batch-launch task.

The plan pins first-party code, data, configurations, and environments to immutable identities when available; if a fidelity-critical official artifact or parameter cannot be established, it uses blocked status and explicit resolution tasks instead of inventing a URL, version, or value.

The independent verification track implements Adam's central update on a deterministic toy gradient sequence and compares moment estimates, bias correction, and parameter updates against the official or paper-faithful path before any full empirical run.
REPRODUCT.md quantifies reported or clearly labeled estimated hardware, storage, time, and cost, distinguishes smoke tests from full reproduction, and links back to notes/00.abstract.md.

evals.name: transformer-architecture-and-evidence
evals.prompt: 请完整阅读 arXiv:1706.03762（Attention Is All You Need）的最新版本，并用中文写一套面向初学者但技术细节完整的精读笔记。需要按章节组织，解释模型的数据流、核心公式、训练与评估、表格和消融实验，同时明确论文证据能支持和不能支持的结论。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese close reading under notes/, a root-level unfilled SUMMARY.CARD.md, and a root-level REPRODUCT.md whose atomic TODOs reproduce the Transformer's central WMT results and ablations through a pinned official path when available and an independent attention check.
expectations: The output root contains REPRODUCT.md, SUMMARY.CARD.md, and notes/00.abstract.md, with ordered note files covering the paper's substantive top-level sections and technical appendices; the bundled validator accepts the output.

SUMMARY.CARD.md contains 8-12 numbered Transformer-specific questions, blank response and confidence fields, a post-check error-repair section, and no answers, hints, expected keywords, or answer key.

The card tests scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional information, masking or autoregressive decoding, central translation evidence, an ablation or counterfactual, limitations, and transfer without stating the answers.
The notes accurately reproduce and unpack the central attention equations, define Q, K, V and relevant dimensions, and explain the scaling term with operational intuition.
The notes trace encoder and decoder data flow, residual connections, normalization, feed-forward layers, positional encoding, and inference masking without conflating their roles.
The evaluation notes explain the translation tasks, metrics, baselines, headline results, training cost, and Table 3 ablations with exact values and source locators where the paper reports them.
The notes separate what the 2017 experiments demonstrate from later claims about Transformers, and discuss meaningful assumptions, limitations, and reproducibility boundaries.

Central formulas, tensor shapes, exact values, comparisons, and limitations are reverse-traceable to source locators; notation remains consistent across files, and every invented example is visibly labeled as teaching material and sanity-checked.

notes/00.abstract.md contains a claim-evidence table, a prerequisite glossary for entering the section notes, a complete linked reading map, and valid relative links to ../SUMMARY.CARD.md and ../REPRODUCT.md.

REPRODUCT.md maps the paper's central WMT14 translation results, computational-cost comparison, and a claim-supporting Table 3 ablation to consecutive targets with exact source locators, acceptance rules, and evidence artifacts.

The official track pins code, WMT data and split preparation, vocabulary or tokenization, base/big configurations, checkpoints or training commands, decoding, BLEU evaluation, and hardware assumptions; unavailable fidelity-critical details become blockers rather than guessed defaults.

The independent track implements scaled dot-product attention and masking on a deterministic fixture, checks intermediate tensors or outputs against the official path, and keeps that check distinct from the full WMT reproduction.

Every reproduction task is unchecked, atomic, dependency ordered, and complete with Action, Run class, Inputs, Produces, Done when, Source, Depends on, and Targets fields; every configuration-seed pair has its own task and smoke tests are distinct from full reproduction.
REPRODUCT.md states reported or labeled-estimate GPU, storage, wall-time, and cost requirements and preserves environment, logs, metrics, generated tables, and deviations in its evidence package.

evals.name: ioannidis-statistical-argument
evals.prompt: 请精读 DOI:10.1371/journal.pmed.0020124（Why Most Published Research Findings Are False），用中文写成适合没有统计学基础读者的分章节学习笔记。请完整重建论文的概率模型和论证链，区分数学模型、作者推论、现实经验判断与尚未验证的部分，并解释表格、例子、偏倚、统计功效和局限。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese close reading under notes/, a root-level unfilled SUMMARY.CARD.md, and a root-level REPRODUCT.md whose atomic TODOs independently reconstruct the paper's PPV model, tables, corollaries, and evidence boundaries without forcing a machine-learning experiment template.
expectations: The output root contains REPRODUCT.md, SUMMARY.CARD.md, and notes/00.abstract.md, with ordered note files covering every substantive top-level section of the article; the bundled validator accepts the output.
SUMMARY.CARD.md contains 8-12 numbered paper-specific questions, blank response and confidence fields, a post-check error-repair section, and no answers, hints, expected keywords, or answer key.

The card tests the PPV model, prior odds, statistical power, alpha, bias, study-field corollaries, evidence boundaries, a counterfactual, and transfer to a concrete research scenario without stating the answers.
The notes accurately derive or explain the positive predictive value relationship, define R, alpha, beta, power, and bias, and give a newcomer-friendly numerical or conceptual example.
The notes explain the article's tables and corollaries, including how changes in prior odds, power, number of teams, flexibility, and bias affect the argument, with source locators.
The notes explicitly distinguish consequences of the mathematical model from empirical measurements of real research fields and avoid treating the title as a universally observed fact.
The notes discuss the model's assumptions, omitted dependencies, applicability boundaries, and the status of the proposed remedies.

Central equations, table values, corollaries, and empirical interpretations are reverse-traceable to source locators; notation remains consistent across files, and every invented example is visibly labeled as teaching material and sanity-checked.

notes/00.abstract.md contains a claim-evidence table, a prerequisite glossary for entering the section notes, a complete linked reading map, and valid relative links to ../SUMMARY.CARD.md and ../REPRODUCT.md.

REPRODUCT.md maps the PPV equations, the paper's table or corollary results, and the boundary between mathematical consequences and empirical claims to consecutive targets with source locators and predefined acceptance rules.

The task list independently derives the PPV relationship, implements a transparent calculation, reproduces representative tabulated values, and runs parameter sweeps over prior odds, power, alpha, and bias with named machine-readable and plotted evidence artifacts.

The plan adapts to an analytical argument rather than inventing model training, GPU, checkpoint, or dataset tasks; it identifies which claims cannot be validated by algebra alone and specifies the additional evidence that would be required.

Every task is unchecked, atomic, dependency ordered, and complete with Action, Run class, Inputs, Produces, Done when, Source, Depends on, and Targets fields, including distinct smoke and independent-full checks of the main calculation.
REPRODUCT.md links back to notes/00.abstract.md, specifies a lightweight environment and resource ledger, and defines an evidence package sufficient to audit each target.

evals.name: mapreduce-systems-and-artifact-gap
evals.prompt: 请精读 MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters（OSDI 2004），用中文为没有分布式系统背景的读者制作完整学习笔记。需要解释编程模型、执行流程、数据分区与 shuffle、容错、局部性、straggler 处理和实验，同时严格区分论文公开证据、工程设计选择和后来生态中的常识。
evals.expected_output: A Chinese systems-paper close reading under notes/, a root-level unfilled SUMMARY.CARD.md, and a blocked or ready REPRODUCT.md that reproduces checkable MapReduce semantics without pretending that an unavailable production artifact can reproduce Google's original cluster results.
expectations: The output root contains REPRODUCT.md, SUMMARY.CARD.md, and notes/00.abstract.md, with ordered note files covering every substantive top-level section and appendix; the bundled validator accepts the output.
The source record uses the most faithful complete first-party representation available, records the exact paper version, and does not mistake an abstract or project page for full text.
The notes give a beginner-friendly end-to-end trace of one concrete job through input splitting, map, partitioning, shuffle and sort, reduce, output, scheduling, and recovery.
The notes distinguish programming-model semantics from implementation policies such as locality scheduling, backup tasks, partitioning, combiner use, and handling of worker or master failures.

The experimental analysis identifies workloads, cluster assumptions, measurements, comparisons, exact reported results, and what those results cannot establish about other environments or later MapReduce systems.
Central mechanisms, exact values, and limitations are reverse-traceable to source locators; terminology remains consistent, and invented teaching examples are labeled and sanity-checked.

SUMMARY.CARD.md contains 8-12 paper-specific questions with blank reader fields and tests execution flow, fault recovery, locality, a counterfactual, evidence boundaries, and transfer without leaking answers.
notes/00.abstract.md contains a claim-evidence table, prerequisite glossary, limitations, complete reading map, and valid links to ../SUMMARY.CARD.md and ../REPRODUCT.md.

REPRODUCT.md maps functional semantics, fault-handling behavior, and central performance or scalability claims to consecutive targets with source locators, acceptance rules, and named evidence artifacts.

A deterministic smoke test and independent implementation may validate the programming model on a small fixture, but neither is presented as reproduction of the original Google-cluster performance evidence.

If the original production implementation, workloads, or cluster configuration cannot be pinned, the plan is blocked for affected targets, uses blocker-class resolution tasks, and makes every affected full or evaluation task depend on those gates.
Every target has a full or evaluation task; all tasks use exact required fields, comma-separated dependencies and targets, valid run classes, unchecked boxes, and observable completion conditions.

The resource ledger places one valid cost marker inside its required region, distinguishes reported values from estimates, and makes hardware, storage, time, access, and artifact limitations explicit.
